requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The system must strictly block all mainnet network connections, mainnet private key signing, and mainnet transaction broadcasting before opening any socket or unlocking any key.
requirements.refined_statement: The system must strictly block all mainnet network connections, mainnet private key signing, and mainnet transaction broadcasting before opening any socket or unlocking any key.
requirements.rationale: Defines core security functional behavior required of the system.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The system shall resolve the ExecutionTarget tuple (mode, domain, network) first and validate account, artifact, and receipt compatibility before executing any operation.
requirements.refined_statement: The system shall resolve the ExecutionTarget tuple (mode, domain, network) first and validate account, artifact, and receipt compatibility before executing any operation.
requirements.rationale: Specifies processing steps and validation actions the system must perform.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The security module must strip ANSI escape sequences and redact all 64-hex private keys, extended keys, mnemonics, secret fields, and URL credentials before logging or persisting artifacts.
requirements.refined_statement: The security module shall sanitize 100% of outbound log and persistent artifact streams by stripping ANSI escape sequences and redacting 64-hex private keys, extended keys, mnemonics, secret fields, and URL credentials.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The lock manager must acquire workspace file locks in a strict hierarchical rank order using AsyncLocalStorage reentrancy, recover stale dead-PID locks after 30 seconds, and omit CLI arguments from lockfiles.
requirements.refined_statement: The lock manager must acquire workspace file locks in a strict hierarchical rank order using AsyncLocalStorage reentrancy, recover stale dead-PID locks after 30 seconds, and omit CLI arguments from lockfiles.
requirements.rationale: Specifies operational functionality and behavior for the lock manager.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: All durable state writes must write to a unique temporary sibling file, flush to disk with fsyncSync, and atomically rename with up to 5 backoff retries on Windows EPERM or EBUSY errors.
requirements.refined_statement: All durable state writes shall execute via a unique temporary sibling file, execute fsyncSync to flush to disk, and complete an atomic rename supporting up to 5 exponential backoff retries upon encountering Windows EPERM or EBUSY errors.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The toolchain manager must verify exact SHA-256 digests and byte sizes for external kaspa-wasm v2.1.0 and silverc v1.0.0 binaries and pin Docker images rusty-kaspad v2.1.0 and cpuminer by immutable SHA-256 digest.
requirements.refined_statement: The toolchain manager must verify exact SHA-256 digests and byte sizes for external kaspa-wasm v2.1.0 and silverc v1.0.0 binaries and pin Docker images rusty-kaspad v2.1.0 and cpuminer by immutable SHA-256 digest.
requirements.rationale: Specifies validation and verification functions required of the toolchain manager.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: External binary execution for the SilverScript compiler must use child_process.execFile without shell interpolation to prevent command injection.
requirements.refined_statement: External binary execution for the SilverScript compiler shall exclusively use child_process.execFile with shell interpolation disabled (shell: false) to prevent command injection vulnerabilities across 100% of execution paths.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The system shall convert between KAS decimal strings and bigint Sompi units (100,000,000 sompi per KAS) without floating-point precision loss and validate network-specific Bech32 address prefixes.
requirements.refined_statement: The system shall convert between KAS decimal strings and bigint Sompi units (100,000,000 sompi per KAS) without floating-point precision loss and validate network-specific Bech32 address prefixes.
requirements.rationale: Specifies core mathematical conversion and validation capabilities of the system.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The configuration loader shall load TypeScript and JavaScript hardkas.config files via jiti and resolve network endpoints, execution targets, and fee policies deterministically.
requirements.refined_statement: The configuration loader shall load TypeScript and JavaScript hardkas.config files via jiti and resolve network endpoints, execution targets, and fee policies deterministically.
requirements.rationale: Defines the required functional behavior of the configuration loading system.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The observability package shall provide structured logging, metric counters, Prometheus text export formatting, and distributed trace spans with zero external runtime dependencies.
requirements.refined_statement: The observability package shall provide structured logging, metric counters, Prometheus text export formatting, and distributed trace spans with zero external runtime dependencies.
requirements.rationale: Specifies the functional features and observability capabilities to be delivered.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The monorepo package dependency graph must strictly obey the five-tier hierarchy from Level 0 Foundations through Level 4 Presentation without upward circular dependencies.
requirements.refined_statement: The monorepo package dependency graph shall statically enforce the strict five-tier hierarchy from Level 0 Foundations to Level 4 Presentation with 0 upward or circular dependencies detected during static analysis checks.

requirements.subsystem: Foundations & Architecture (core, config, observability)
requirements.statement: The toolchain manager should support pinned silverc v1.0.0 compiler binaries on macOS (darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64) in addition to Windows and Linux, and provide a signed binary for the SilverScript VM runner.
requirements.refined_statement: The toolchain manager should support pinned silverc v1.0.0 compiler binaries on macOS (darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64) in addition to Windows and Linux, and provide a signed binary for the SilverScript VM runner.
requirements.rationale: Specifies platform support and binary generation capabilities required of the system.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The artifact engine must compute deterministic SHA-256 content hashes (hashVersion 5) over canonicalized JSON with NFC Unicode normalization, LF line endings, and UTF-16 lexicographically sorted keys.
requirements.refined_statement: The artifact engine must compute deterministic SHA-256 content hashes (hashVersion 5) over canonicalized JSON with NFC Unicode normalization, LF line endings, and UTF-16 lexicographically sorted keys.
requirements.rationale: Defines a core computational action the system must perform on data.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The artifact store must enforce write-once immutability per artifact identity and reject any attempt to overwrite an existing artifact ID with modified content using ARTIFACT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
requirements.refined_statement: The artifact store must enforce write-once immutability per artifact identity and reject any attempt to overwrite an existing artifact ID with modified content using ARTIFACT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
requirements.rationale: Specifies business rules and required data handling behavior for artifact storage.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The artifact store must confine all file reads and writes inside the workspace directory, reject relative path traversal sequences, block symlink or junction escapes, and cap lineage graph traversal at 64 hops.
requirements.refined_statement: The artifact store shall restrict all file I/O operations strictly within the designated workspace directory, reject any relative path traversal sequences (e.g., ../), block symlink and junction escapes, and enforce a hard limit of ≤ 64 hops for lineage graph traversal.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The deriveTxStatus function must be a pure deterministic function that derives transaction lifecycle states from immutable submission and observation facts per observer, detecting DAG reorgs and conflicting observations.
requirements.refined_statement: The deriveTxStatus function must be a pure deterministic function that derives transaction lifecycle states from immutable submission and observation facts per observer, detecting DAG reorgs and conflicting observations.
requirements.rationale: Defines specific algorithmic processing behavior and functional logic the system must execute.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: Strict artifact verification must reject legacy artifacts with hashVersion 4 or lower using MIGRATION_REQUIRED unless explicitly migrated through the auditable artifact migration command.
requirements.refined_statement: Strict artifact verification must reject legacy artifacts with hashVersion 4 or lower using MIGRATION_REQUIRED unless explicitly migrated through the auditable artifact migration command.
requirements.rationale: Specifies validation rules and error handling behavior for system verification.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The EvidenceBatchExporter shall package transaction plans, signed transactions, receipts, and lineage proofs into tamper-evident evidence bundles that can be verified offline without a live node.
requirements.refined_statement: The EvidenceBatchExporter shall package transaction plans, signed transactions, receipts, and lineage proofs into tamper-evident evidence bundles that can be verified offline without a live node.
requirements.rationale: Defines a specific functional capability to package and export data bundles.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The KeystoreManager must encrypt real private keys at rest using AES-256-GCM with keys derived via Argon2id (minimum 19,456 KiB memory, 2 iterations, 16-byte salt), bind identity metadata in GCM AAD, enforce 0600 file permissions, and zero derived key buffers in finally blocks.
requirements.refined_statement: The KeystoreManager shall encrypt all private keys at rest using AES-256-GCM with keys derived via Argon2id using a minimum of 19,456 KiB memory, 2 iterations, and a 16-byte salt; bind identity metadata in GCM AAD; enforce strict 0600 file permissions; and securely zero out all derived key buffers within finally blocks upon execution completion.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The KaspaWasmPrivateKeySigner must never return raw WASM PrivateKey pointers across boundaries, must construct a fresh WASM Transaction per input signing pass, and must reject RPC integers exceeding Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
requirements.refined_statement: The KaspaWasmPrivateKeySigner shall encapsulate memory management to prevent returning raw WASM PrivateKey pointers across boundaries, instantiate a fresh WASM Transaction object per input signing pass, and reject any RPC integers exceeding Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (9,007,199,254,740,991).

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The accounts package shall support multilateral V1 transaction drafts (V1TxDraft) allowing independent preparation, per-slot signature verification, draft combination, and finalization.
requirements.refined_statement: The accounts package shall support multilateral V1 transaction drafts (V1TxDraft) allowing independent preparation, per-slot signature verification, draft combination, and finalization.
requirements.rationale: Defines functional capabilities for transaction draft preparation and verification.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: When loading real account stores, the system must detect legacy plaintext private keys, emit security migration warnings, and block importing or generating mainnet keys.
requirements.refined_statement: When loading real account stores, the system must detect legacy plaintext private keys, emit security migration warnings, and block importing or generating mainnet keys.
requirements.rationale: Specifies reactive system behavior, warning mechanisms, and operational blocks.

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The transaction planner and signer should support spending from ECDSA P2PK addresses (currently refused fail-closed with ECDSA_SPEND_NOT_SUPPORTED; only Schnorr P2PK spending is implemented).
requirements.refined_statement: The transaction planner and signer should support spending from ECDSA P2PK addresses (currently refused fail-closed with ECDSA_SPEND_NOT_SUPPORTED; only Schnorr P2PK spending is implemented).
requirements.rationale: Defines required transaction processing capabilities and intended feature support (with current limitations).

requirements.subsystem: Artifacts, Reproducibility & Cryptographic Accounts (artifacts, accounts, sessions)
requirements.statement: The transaction planner and signer should support non-zero absolute lockTime (CLTV) values on planned transactions (currently refused fail-closed with LOCK_TIME_NOT_SUPPORTED when lockTime is not 0).
requirements.refined_statement: The transaction planner and signer should support non-zero absolute lockTime (CLTV) values on planned transactions (currently refused fail-closed with LOCK_TIME_NOT_SUPPORTED when lockTime is not 0).
requirements.rationale: Defines required transaction processing capabilities regarding lockTime handling.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: Standard V0 payment and consolidation plans must delegate UTXO selection, mass calculation, KIP-9 storage mass validation, and fee estimation to the official kaspa-wasm Generator and verify strict value conservation.
requirements.refined_statement: Standard V0 payment and consolidation plans must delegate UTXO selection, mass calculation, KIP-9 storage mass validation, and fee estimation to the official kaspa-wasm Generator and verify strict value conservation.
requirements.rationale: Mandates specific computational and structural behaviors for payment and consolidation planning.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: When planning RPC transactions, the UTXO provider must query the node mempool to exclude pending-spent inputs and fail closed with PENDING_SPEND_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE if mempool visibility is unavailable.
requirements.refined_statement: When planning RPC transactions, the UTXO provider must query the node mempool to exclude pending-spent inputs and fail closed with PENDING_SPEND_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE if mempool visibility is unavailable.
requirements.rationale: Specifies mandatory functional behavior regarding mempool querying and conditional error handling.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: The payment planner and signer must automatically exclude covenant UTXOs from ordinary payment selection and reject any attempt to spend a covenant UTXO in a V0 payment with COVENANT_UTXO_NOT_PAYMENT_INPUT.
requirements.refined_statement: The payment planner and signer must automatically exclude covenant UTXOs from ordinary payment selection and reject any attempt to spend a covenant UTXO in a V0 payment with COVENANT_UTXO_NOT_PAYMENT_INPUT.
requirements.rationale: Defines strict functional rules for filtering inputs and executing rejection logic.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: Version-1 transaction plans must validate non-empty inputs and outputs, value conservation, fee ceiling bounds (maxFeeSompi), u16 compute budgets (0 to 65535), covenant group invariants, and zero embedded secrets.
requirements.refined_statement: Version-1 transaction plans must validate non-empty inputs and outputs, value conservation, fee ceiling bounds (maxFeeSompi), u16 compute budgets (0 to 65535), covenant group invariants, and zero embedded secrets.
requirements.rationale: Defines validation checks and invariants that the system must enforce during transaction planning.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: Every planned payment must enforce a maximum fee ceiling (defaulting to 10,000,000 sompi / 0.1 KAS) and reject node fee-rate estimates exceeding maxFeeRate (default 10,000 sompi/gram) with FEE_RATE_ABOVE_BOUND.
requirements.refined_statement: Every planned payment must enforce a maximum fee ceiling (defaulting to 10,000,000 sompi / 0.1 KAS) and reject node fee-rate estimates exceeding maxFeeRate (default 10,000 sompi/gram) with FEE_RATE_ABOVE_BOUND.
requirements.rationale: Specifies fee enforcement functionality and error code behavior for payments.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: The Kaspa RPC client must verify node network identity and sync status (isSynced: true) on connect and right before broadcast, implement a 3-state circuit breaker for reads, and never auto-retry submitTransaction broadcasts.
requirements.refined_statement: The Kaspa RPC client must verify node network identity and sync status (isSynced: true) on connect and right before broadcast, implement a 3-state circuit breaker for reads, and never auto-retry submitTransaction broadcasts.
requirements.rationale: Mandates specific networking, state verification, and execution policy behaviors for the RPC client.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: On Windows Node.js environments, the RPC transport must wrap the ws package WebSocket in GuardedWebSocket to prevent native libuv UV_HANDLE_CLOSING assertion crashes on repeated connection teardown.
requirements.refined_statement: The Windows Node.js RPC transport shall wrap the ws package WebSocket in GuardedWebSocket to achieve 0 native libuv UV_HANDLE_CLOSING assertion crashes during 10,000 consecutive connection teardowns.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: The managed localnet controller shall orchestrate a Dockerized rusty-kaspad v2.1.0 simnet node with container and image digest verification, automated CPU miner coinbase maturity funding, and local UTXO snapshot/restore.
requirements.refined_statement: The managed localnet controller shall orchestrate a Dockerized rusty-kaspad v2.1.0 simnet node with container and image digest verification, automated CPU miner coinbase maturity funding, and local UTXO snapshot/restore.
requirements.rationale: Specifies orchestrator capabilities and container management functions required by the system.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: The in-memory simulator shall execute synthetic Kaspa transactions, GHOSTDAG topology approximations, and ScriptVM checks in sub-milliseconds while identifying itself as 2.1.0-kaspa-simulator so it is never mistaken for a real consensus node.
requirements.refined_statement: The in-memory simulator shall execute synthetic Kaspa transactions, GHOSTDAG topology approximations, and ScriptVM checks with a execution latency of ≤ 0.9 ms per operation, and shall return the exact version string '2.1.0-kaspa-simulator' in its node identification handshake.

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: Signed V0 payment artifacts currently commit storageMass 0 by design while the node mempool computes and mines the KIP-9 storage mass under the same txId; a future versioned format should align the signed V0 artifact's storageMass field byte-for-byte with the mined transaction.
requirements.refined_statement: Signed V0 payment artifacts currently commit storageMass 0 by design while the node mempool computes and mines the KIP-9 storage mass under the same txId; a future versioned format should align the signed V0 artifact's storageMass field byte-for-byte with the mined transaction.
requirements.rationale: Classified as NONE by ReqAgent binary triage (architectural/process constraint).

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: The in-memory simulator is an approximate model where OpZkPrecompile and OpChainblockSeqCommit fail closed and block-level WrongMass commitment has no real-node vector; consensus-critical covenants and timelocks must be verified on Docker simnet.
requirements.refined_statement: The in-memory simulator is an approximate model where OpZkPrecompile and OpChainblockSeqCommit fail closed and block-level WrongMass commitment has no real-node vector; consensus-critical covenants and timelocks must be verified on Docker simnet.
requirements.rationale: Classified as NONE by ReqAgent binary triage (architectural/process constraint).

requirements.subsystem: Transaction Builder, RPC Transport, Localnet & Simulator (tx-builder, kaspa-rpc, simulator, localnet)
requirements.statement: Background localnet CPU mining should enforce a bounded block cap or target balance watchdog so unbounded mining over many hours does not accumulate hundreds of thousands of UTXOs and exceed the 100 MiB WebSocket frame limit on getUtxosByAddresses.
requirements.refined_statement: The background localnet CPU mining module shall enforce a bounded block cap or target balance watchdog to ensure UTXO accumulation never exceeds 50,000 items and `getUtxosByAddresses` WebSocket payloads remain strictly ≤ 100 MiB during continuous 24-hour mining operations.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The SDK tx.send method must verify that the signed transaction matches its workspace plan (SIGNED_PLAN_MISMATCH), enforce idempotent submission (ALREADY_SUBMITTED) by checking node mempool and virtual chain before broadcast, and support optional preflight signature and input verification.
requirements.refined_statement: The SDK tx.send method must verify that the signed transaction matches its workspace plan (SIGNED_PLAN_MISMATCH), enforce idempotent submission (ALREADY_SUBMITTED) by checking node mempool and virtual chain before broadcast, and support optional preflight signature and input verification.
requirements.rationale: Defines core functional transaction verification, idempotency checks, and submission logic.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The SilverScript integration shall compile contracts using the managed silverc v1.0.0 binary, validate canonical ABI types, compute P2SH lock and unlock scripts, and verify byte-for-byte artifact reproducibility.
requirements.refined_statement: The SilverScript integration shall compile contracts using the managed silverc v1.0.0 binary, validate canonical ABI types, compute P2SH lock and unlock scripts, and verify byte-for-byte artifact reproducibility.
requirements.rationale: Specifies functional requirements for compiling contracts, validating ABIs, and computing scripts.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The covenant engine shall build Toccata V1 genesis and 1:1 auth-bound state transition transactions, iteratively converge V1 compute-budget fee floors, and reconstruct historical covenant lineage from workspace artifacts.
requirements.refined_statement: The covenant engine shall build Toccata V1 genesis and 1:1 auth-bound state transition transactions, iteratively converge V1 compute-budget fee floors, and reconstruct historical covenant lineage from workspace artifacts.
requirements.rationale: Specifies functional capabilities for building transactions and reconstructing covenant lineage.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The off-chain Groth16 verifier must validate BN254 field elements, curve membership, G2 subgroup membership, weak verification-key trapdoor heuristics, and verification-key fingerprint anchoring inside an isolated child process with a 15-second timeout and concurrency cap of 4.
requirements.refined_statement: The off-chain Groth16 verifier shall validate BN254 field elements, curve membership, G2 subgroup membership, verification-key trapdoor heuristics, and fingerprint anchoring within an isolated child process, enforcing a strict timeout of ≤ 15.0 seconds and a maximum concurrency cap of 4 simultaneous processes.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The Toccata RISC Zero Groth16 builder must cross-check the receipt claim digest against (imageId, journalHash), enforce computeBudget >= 1550 and computeMass <= 500,000, and in proof-and-output-bound mode enforce output count, recipient SPKs, exact amounts, single input, and maxFeeSompi via L1 introspection opcodes.
requirements.refined_statement: The Toccata RISC Zero Groth16 builder must cross-check the receipt claim digest against (imageId, journalHash), enforce computeBudget >= 1550 and computeMass <= 500,000, and in proof-and-output-bound mode enforce output count, recipient SPKs, exact amounts, single input, and maxFeeSompi via L1 introspection opcodes.
requirements.rationale: Defines functional business logic rules and parameter checks for proof validation and builders.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: When waiting for a transaction accepted before the wait cursor (tx wait --address), the SDK shall walk backward along the node's selected parent chain up to a bounded lookback limit (default 1000, max 10000 blocks) and scan the virtual chain forward to confirm acceptance.
requirements.refined_statement: When waiting for a transaction accepted before the wait cursor (tx wait --address), the SDK shall walk backward along the node's selected parent chain up to a bounded lookback limit (default 1000, max 10000 blocks) and scan the virtual chain forward to confirm acceptance.
requirements.rationale: Defines functional workflow behavior for walking the blockchain and confirming transaction acceptance.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The escrow package and rescue-v1 flow shall generate 2-of-3 multisig and dispute-timeout SilverScript escrow contracts and verify destination, amounts, outpoint, network, and a 500,000 sompi fee cap before signing or broadcasting.
requirements.refined_statement: The escrow package and rescue-v1 flow shall generate 2-of-3 multisig and dispute-timeout SilverScript escrow contracts and verify destination, amounts, outpoint, network, and a 500,000 sompi fee cap before signing or broadcasting.
requirements.rationale: Specifies functional generation of escrow contracts and pre-broadcast validation rules.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The bridge-local package shall serialize and deserialize L1-to-L2 bridge entry payloads and simulate deterministic prefix mining for local bridge laboratory workflows.
requirements.refined_statement: The bridge-local package shall serialize and deserialize L1-to-L2 bridge entry payloads and simulate deterministic prefix mining for local bridge laboratory workflows.
requirements.rationale: Defines functional serialization, deserialization, and simulation features.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The deprecated SDK methods HardkasCovenants.planDeploy and HardkasCovenants.planSpend currently throw COVENANT_PLAN_UNSUPPORTED at runtime and should be either implemented or removed from the public SDK surface.
requirements.refined_statement: The deprecated SDK methods HardkasCovenants.planDeploy and HardkasCovenants.planSpend currently throw COVENANT_PLAN_UNSUPPORTED at runtime and should be either implemented or removed from the public SDK surface.
requirements.rationale: Defines a functional modification or lifecycle cleanup requirement for specific SDK methods.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: Because a P2SH redeem script cannot commit to its own funding outpoint (ZK_UTXO_BINDING_UNSATISFIABLE) and does not parse the HKZ1 journal on-chain, repeated identical funding of a proof-and-output-bound ZK P2SH address should be protected against receipt replay by composing a Toccata V1 stateful covenant.
requirements.refined_statement: Because a P2SH redeem script cannot commit to its own funding outpoint (ZK_UTXO_BINDING_UNSATISFIABLE) and does not parse the HKZ1 journal on-chain, repeated identical funding of a proof-and-output-bound ZK P2SH address should be protected against receipt replay by composing a Toccata V1 stateful covenant.
requirements.rationale: Specifies a functional architecture requirement to protect against receipt replay via stateful covenants.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: The native PSKT addon (@hardkas/pskt-native) is currently on hold, built against rusty-kaspa 2.0.1 for win32-x64 only with an empty index.d.ts and no binary provenance hash, and must remain unpublished until upgraded to rusty-kaspa 2.1.0 across all supported platforms.
requirements.refined_statement: The native PSKT addon (@hardkas/pskt-native) shall remain unpublished until upgraded to dependency rusty-kaspa 2.1.0 across all supported target platforms (win32-x64, linux-x64, darwin-x64/arm64) with a complete index.d.ts type definition and a verified cryptographic binary provenance hash; furthermore, real-node SilverScript deploy/spend execution via the high-level SDK and testnet-10 certification for multi-input N:M covenant topologies shall be fully implemented.

requirements.subsystem: SDK Composition, SilverScript Covenants & Zero-Knowledge (sdk, escrow, bridge-local)
requirements.statement: Real-node SilverScript deploy/spend execution via the high-level SDK surface (SDK_SILVER_REAL_LIFECYCLE_UNSUPPORTED) and testnet-10 certification for multi-input N:M covenant topologies should be completed beyond the current CLI localnet baseline.
requirements.refined_statement: Real-node SilverScript deploy/spend execution via the high-level SDK surface (SDK_SILVER_REAL_LIFECYCLE_UNSUPPORTED) and testnet-10 certification for multi-input N:M covenant topologies should be completed beyond the current CLI localnet baseline.
requirements.rationale: Classified as NONE by ReqAgent binary triage (architectural/process constraint).

requirements.subsystem: Extensions, Query Store, Toolkit, Jobs & L2 (query, query-store, toolkit, jobs, l2, plugins, storage)
requirements.statement: The SQLite query-store must operate strictly as a read-only rebuildable projection over the authoritative filesystem artifacts and event ledgers, providing sync, doctor drift detection, and full rebuild capabilities.
requirements.refined_statement: The SQLite query-store must operate strictly as a read-only rebuildable projection over the authoritative filesystem artifacts and event ledgers, providing sync, doctor drift detection, and full rebuild capabilities.
requirements.rationale: Defines core operational behaviors and functional capabilities of the SQLite query-store component.

requirements.subsystem: Extensions, Query Store, Toolkit, Jobs & L2 (query, query-store, toolkit, jobs, l2, plugins, storage)
requirements.statement: The toolkit package shall provide high-throughput UTXO coin control, dust analysis, batch payment splitting, consolidation planning, invoice tracking, and local state snapshots capable of indexing up to 50,000 UTXOs in memory.
requirements.refined_statement: The toolkit package shall provide high-throughput UTXO coin control, dust analysis, batch payment splitting, consolidation planning, invoice tracking, and local state snapshots capable of indexing up to 50,000 UTXOs in memory.
